categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Has Wallet label and modifies wallet migration and database handling across src/wallet/wallet.cpp, src/wallet/db.cpp, and walletdb.cpp.
categories.rationale: Prevents potential wallet database corruption and data loss during legacy-to-descriptor migration. On master, the migration routine 'deletes the original database before writing the new one and asserts if anything fails after that' (ryanofsky), and unhandled stale SQLite journal files could overwrite pages in the newly migrated database.
